svg.text: Wallet-gated / GPU-exclusive sessions / WebRTC 60fps NVFBC / Heartbeat billing / desktop.axonos.io
legacy - ETH deposits active in prod
GATE CONTAINER / container: axonos / image: axonos:public-beta
supervisord manages: xorg-nvidia xfce4 x11vnc novnc axgt-api webrtc-agent ollama jupyterlab ipfs
mode: http / axonos-launcher:8090 / multi-session enabled / default profile: small
GPU SESSION CONTAINER / axgt-session-{id} / image: axonos:public-beta
up to 8 GPUs (max profile) / --gpus device=N,M,... / shm-size 32g / CUDA 12.2
ENV -> AXGT_SESSION_ID AXGT_WALLET_ADDRESS AXGT_REQUESTED_PROFILE AXGT_ASSIGNED_GPU_IDS AXGT_DESKTOP_ENABLED=true
DOCKER HOST / Linux / NVIDIA driver / /var/run/docker.sock / NVIDIA Container Toolkit
Network: axonos_stack (bridge) / Volume: axonos_postgres_data (persistent) / GPU passthrough via NVIDIA CTK
Containers: axonos (:6080 :8889) / axonos_session_launcher (:8090) / axonos_postgres (:5432 internal) / axgt-session-N (spawned per wallet claim)
1 Wallet ECDSA challenge -> auth_token (30 min TTL)
2 Deposit ETH -> on-chain verify -> prepaid min (~$0.99/hr)
Heartbeat every 30-60s deducts elapsed_min x gpu_count / session paused on credit exhaust / TURN servers: turn.axondao.io:3478
